generator: tools/blender/market_render.py + market_pack.py (v4.2.0.2 M1: the first shop's stall stages)

conventions.anchor: normalised [ax, ay] of the full untrimmed frame = world origin = footprint centre.
conventions.layers: <stage>_back = the whole stall (posts, shelf, signboard, step, counter); <stage>_front = only the counter and what stands on it (same frame + anchor). Draw back (depth d), the clerk at staffPoints[0] lifted by stepLiftPx (d + 0.5), front (d + 1).
conventions.points: every *Point(s) value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the sprite anchor (unscaled sprite).
conventions.staffPoints: the clerk's feet on the plank step, projected to the ground (z = 0); stepLiftPx = how far the sprite is drawn higher because the clerk stands on the step.
conventions.customerPoints: where the first customer of the line stands: diagonally front-left of the clerk, so the front customer does not stand between the camera and the clerk.
conventions.signQuad: the 4 corners [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left] of the blank signboard face (it faces world -Y: the top edge slopes down to the right, 1 px down per 2 px across). The game writes the stage name (signText = a strings.js key) into it, sheared the same way.

market_s1_back.notes: Stage-1 food stall 「눈꽃 노점」 (v4.2.0.2): no awning, a blank wooden signboard on two back posts (top edge 2.6 m, the GAME writes the name into signQuad), a 0.6 m counter, a 12 cm plank step behind it. Draw market_s1_back (depth d), the clerk standing at staffPoints[0] lifted by stepLiftPx (d + 0.5), then market_s1_front (d + 1, same frame + anchor: only the counter and what stands on it). Goods-free: the real stock is the shelf pad's item tower.

market_s1_front.notes: Front layer of market_s1_back (same frame + anchor): the counter and what stands on it (object mask: only the builder's front layer). Draw it ABOVE the clerk (d + 1).

market_s2_back.notes: Stage-2 shop 「눈꽃 가게」 (v4.3): two 2 m counters in one row - the 자재 창구 (materials) at the WEST end, the food counter east of it - a blank signboard (the game writes the name) and a blank name plate over each counter (plates[k]: the game writes 자재 / 먹거리 and draws the item icon). staffPoints / customerPoints / registerPoints west -> east, one per counter. Back (depth d) -> clerks on the step (d + 0.5) -> front = the counters (d + 1). Goods-free: the stock towers are the game's shelf pads 1.1 m beyond each end of the row.

market_s2_front.notes: Front layer of market_s2_back (same frame + anchor): the counter and what stands on it (object mask: only the builder's front layer). Draw it ABOVE the clerk (d + 1).

market_sled.notes: The old trade post's merchant sled without its canopy (v4.3 decor: the trade post is the shop's 자재 창구 now). Front faces screen down-left (world -Y); runners curl up at +X.

market_s3_back.notes: Stage-3 market 「눈꽃 시장」 (v4.3): three 2 m counters in one row - 자재 (WEST end) · 생선 · 빵·고기 - a blank signboard and a blank plate over each counter (the sign of each line). Same layers, points and rules as stage 2.

market_s3_front.notes: Front layer of market_s3_back (same frame + anchor): the counter and what stands on it (object mask: only the builder's front layer). Draw it ABOVE the clerk (d + 1).

market_sled_s3.notes: The same sled on the stage-3 page (review CD-2: at stage 3 the market_s2 page is not loaded at all).

market_s4_back.notes: Stage-4 market 「눈꽃마을 시장」 (v4.3 step B): three counters in one row - 자재 (WEST end, 3.0 m, two windows) · 생선 · 고기 (2.0 m each) - under an open roof (~3.6 m) on the back posts; the stage name on an arch board on the roof's front beam (signQuad: the game writes it), a blank plate over each counter on the back rail. staffPoints / customerPoints / registerPoints west -> east, one per counter (the 자재 점원's window = the east window of the 자재 counter); staff2Points / customer2Points / register2Points = the 자재 counter's second (west) window: the second merchant spot. Same layers and rules as stages 2-3.

market_s4_front.notes: Front layer of market_s4_back (same frame + anchor): the counter and what stands on it (object mask: only the builder's front layer). Draw it ABOVE the clerk (d + 1).

market_sled_s4.notes: The old sled on the market_s4 page (copied pixel for pixel from market_s2): at stage 4 the earlier pages are not loaded.
